metadata.description: Agent harness: PR review and commit tooling, guard hooks, run-tracking and session mods

plugins.name: harness
plugins.description: Skills, agents, hooks and scripts for PR review, commit breakdowns, PR summaries and worktree flow

plugins.name: arc-straps
plugins.description: ArcGIS Pro toolbox skills: arc-meta checks and applies tool help in a project's .atbx archive; arc-help-pages builds and checks each tool's linked help page

plugins.name: agent-watcher
plugins.description: Logs every agent dispatch and forked skill with engine-measured usage rows; tracks pr-review / pr-team runs: Phase 5 band, matrix rows, bubble Stop guard

plugins.name: session-bookmark
plugins.description: Compaction bookmark: git state, last prompts, session notes and /compact instructions kept in session state and appended to the compacted conversation, and an optional /goal hook switch

plugins.name: git-status
plugins.description: Git snapshot, per-prompt GIT_STATE context and a fallback git status line that gives way to ccstatusline or band-line

plugins.name: banner-status
plugins.description: Banner options: /setup-statusline makes ccstatusline the project's status line (git branch and uncommitted changes, model, thinking effort and context window, and the working-refs line as an optional third line)

plugins.name: band-line
plugins.description: oStraps banner in a band above the prompt (git-status's git state, model, context window, and the working-refs line as a second band line when that mod is installed); clears git-status's own status line

plugins.name: working-refs
plugins.description: The plans, TODO ids and issues the current branch works on, then every other branch's override, as one line for the ccstatusline widget and band-line

plugins.name: pytest-scope
plugins.description: Routes bare pytest through the project interpreter and requires a test file or node-id per pytest run

plugins.name: todo-watch
plugins.description: The next TODO items and a live sync status line in a band above the prompt (kept until dismissed, or optionally one toast at session start), TODO_SYNC drift context and /todo, backed by the harness todo_sync checks

plugins.name: bubble-stamp
plugins.description: Stamps recorded pr-review decisions (RESOLVED, CLOSED_NO_ACTION, REFUTED) into the bubble memo, PR_<N>_Bubbles.md

plugins.name: parallel2-lanes
plugins.description: parallel2 lanes: a lane's Agent spawn starts with its brief inline, the plan's model and its worktree; a band lists each run's lane status

plugins.name: superpowers-lt
plugins.description: Trimmed fork of the superpowers skills library, renamed so its skills do not collide with the upstream plugin
